items.quote:
You need to report your arrival to Columbia if you are:
- ✔︎ | a new student with a Columbia I-20/DS-2019 who arrived in the U.S. in F-1/J-1 status.
- ✔︎ | a new student with a Columbia I-20 who transferred your SEVIS record from another U.S. school.
- ✔︎ | returning from a leave of absence with a new I-20/DS-2019.
- ✔︎ | re-entering the U.S. with a new Columbia I-20/DS-2019 to regain student status.

It's mandatory to report your arrival within a week of your first-time arrival with this Columbia I-20/DS-2019.
This is a government requirement and will activate your SEVIS record. The online form meets the requirement—you do not need to report your arrival in person.
